summary.zh: 按风险与可逆性划分 AI 自主与人工审核边界
summary.en: Decide when AI acts alone and when a human must review

description.zh: 在把营销或 GTM 流程交给 AI 执行前，按风险和可逆程度为每个环节定级：AI 主导、人机协作或人工主导。也用于起草内部 AI 审核制度。
description.en: Before letting AI or an agent run a marketing or GTM workflow unaided, this sets each step as AI-primary, collaborative or human-primary based on stakes and reversibility. Also helps draft review policies.
